name: Italian Edibles Ltd.
summary: Italian Edibles Ltd. is an India-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse range of confectionery products. Its product portfolio includes chocolates, lollipops, candies, jelly-based sweets, rabdi (milk sweet), milk paste, chocolate paste, multi-grain puff rolls, fruit-based products, and wafers. The company operates within the food processing industry, serving both domestic and international markets. Domestically, it targets consumers across India, with a particular focus on teenagers, young adults, and children in rural and semi-urban areas. Italian Edibles Ltd. also exports its products to various international markets, including countries in Africa and the Middle East such as Nigeria, Yemen, Senegal, and Sudan. The company is based in Indore, India, where it also operates its manufacturing units.
